user.title: Connect Hager flow
user.description:
Sign in at {portal_url}, then open the browser developer tools (F12) and copy the value of `reAuthToken` from Application → Local Storage.

The serial number is shown in the portal title bar and in its URL.

data_description.serial: The 12-digit number shown in the portal
data_description.reauth_token: Valid for about 30 days. Home Assistant will ask for a new one when it expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Hager flow
reauth_confirm.description: The refresh token for installation {serial} has expired. Sign in at {portal_url} again and copy the current `reAuthToken` from Application → Local Storage.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Hager flow portal.
error.invalid_auth: The refresh token was rejected. Please copy a current one from the portal.
error.unknown_serial: No installation found with this serial number.

abort.already_configured: This installation is already set up.
